deviation_note: Amended 2026-09-05 in Session 12. Seven deviations are recorded in the v2 plan's `deviations` array. Two were made before any corresponding data existed (E0 withdrawn, E1 dose-response added ahead of S13) and are pre-registered in the sense that matters. Five correct work that had already been done under the v1 lock -- E6/E7 admitted as post-hoc, the Dirichlet pointer corrected, the Level-0 panel moved off unregistered test reads, the Mahalanobis test arm deleted, and the conformal score function repaired. Those five are amendments to a broken record, not pre-registration, and are labelled as such wherever their numbers are reported.
